requestId.description: Corresponds to EpisodeSearchResponse.searchRequestId. Must come from the search response; do not generate a new UUID on the frontend.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the click occurred.

query.description: The search query string (same as the corresponding query log).

selectedLang.description: Language selected by the user when searching.

clickedEpisodeId.description: ID of the episode the user clicked. Format: episode:{source}:{showId}:{episodeId}

clickedRank.description: 1-based rank of the clicked episode in the result list.

clickedLanguage.description: Language index of the clicked episode. Used to calculate same-language click rate.

timeToClickSec.description: Seconds from search result display to click. Optional; used for user decision speed analysis.
